title: Poor Suction
text: Poor Suction. I bought this almost two years ago and finally am throwing it out.  It spends more time on the floor of the sink than stuck to the side of it.  I have tried cleaning the suction cups, drying them, etc., but nothing works.  If I'm lucky, it sticks once in a while for maybe up to a day. I expect more from Rubbermaid.  I may try one more time, but if I do and it isn't sticking properly after a few weeks, I won't be lazy this time and will send it back.
